text:
maria: heads up — customer ACME reports sudden spike in billed 5xx for streaming responses. they cancel in client and we see write errors in gateway.

maria: ticket https://acme.zendesk/12345 — they included curl repro and trace

support-bot: ticket created SUP-9123 :ticket:

dan: can you paste the gateway logs around the timestamps? what do the backend logs show?

maria: here's snippet from gateway at 2025-05-12T14:12:03Z
```
gateway: write tcp 10.0.0.5:443->10.1.2.3:52344: broken pipe
proxy: labeled request 5xx due to upstream write failure
```

maria: client side debug shows it sent FIN immediately after last chunk, then reconnected

kevin: interesting — is Transfer-Encoding: chunked with chunk-trailer used? any Content-Length? any proxies in path doing chunk coalescing?

maria: no Content-Length, chunked. customer uses a browser extension that streams with small chunks (~1-2KB). path: client -> CDN -> our gateway -> model-backend

dan: I suspect our metric classifier treats any upstream write error as 5xx. need to distinguish client-initiated EOF (499) vs true upstream error (5xx). can you capture tcpdump + proxy logs for one repro? sample pcap would help.

maria: attaching pcap in ticket (link obfuscated). also captured edge logs showing client's FIN hits CDN before gateway returned status.

kevin: quick mitigation: change gateway to inspect socket write error code and check if remote closed already. if remote closed -> mark as client-cancel and don't bill. we'll try a small patch and staged rollout to beta customers.

dan: agree. also add an e2e test that simulates client FIN mid-stream with chunked encoding to ensure we return 499/aborted-not-5xx and no billing.

maria: customer asked for an ETA — can we get a quick hotfix? they saw ~14% of stream sessions in last 24h flagged 5xx.

kevin: I can push a hotfix targeting the heuristic tomorrow morning EU windows. I'll add feature flag and rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% with metrics on billed_5xx_count and client_cancel_count.

maria: perfect. I'll update customer and include repro steps to verify once deployed. thanks :pray:

support-bot: patch deployment scheduled by kevin for 2025-05-13T06:00Z UTC
